goal: Research-only offline historical stress test of close-confirmed profit triggers followed by monotone staged stop-loss ratchet; not the previously rejected static RR stop or previous partial-loss trim.
execution_contract: 100% of available account cash on original MR40+Momentum30 buy signal at next candle OPEN. Trigger if any last fully closed 4h candle CLOSE >= first executed buy price*(1+trigger). On a subsequent OPEN, ratchet active STOP to first buy price*(1+specified stop offset). Never lower STOP, never use future CLOSE/HIGH for activation, never activate same candle. If OPEN <= stop, stop execution at OPEN less sell-side slippage (gap); else if candle LOW <= stop, execute at stop less sell-side slippage. Fees on each buy/sell. No intrabar profit-trigger activation. If native MR40 Z>=0 natural exit was scheduled for same OPEN, natural exit takes priority and no stop later. With lag=2, all signal/trigger decisions delayed two candles consistently; stops once armed stay active each next bar. After stop exit block re-entry until signal episode ends (avoid same episode churn). If stop never arms, natural exit and terminal liquidation unchanged. BTC lot=.00001 and notional>=1 USDT. No leverage, no order calls.
frozen_selection: Training qualification profitability: normal PnL >= baseline; stress PnL >= baseline*1.05; worst of normal/stress close DD <= baseline*1.10. Training qualification downside-efficiency: normal CAGR >=0.75*baseline, stress CAGR >0, worst close DD <=0.90*baseline, stressCAGR/worstDD >= 1.10*baseline. Profit winner maximizes training stress PnL. Efficiency winner maximizes training stressCAGR/worstDD. If none, baseline. Evaluation pass if independently reset normal and stress PnL each >= 75% baseline, normal and stress worst close DD <=80% baseline worst, and stressCAGR/worstDD >=1.10 baseline. Also report Low-based drawdown with fully chronological open-before-low assumptions; it does not convert observed histories into untouched future evidence.
validation: Pinned immutable previously captured inputs, all baseline fills/equity parity, independent Decimal ledger recon for entries/stops/exits/cash/low marks, synthetic stop gaps/trigger chronology/ratchet monotonicity/priority/reentry-block, temporal prefix invariance. Freeze policy before any historical computation. Never re-download market data.
